name: Data Analyzer: Full analysis of a small employee table finds the one planted age error
objective: Loads made-up CSV text and runs all checks with a schema and rules. Proves the analysis passes row-count and data-type checks, fails the value-range check, and reports exactly one issue: the age of 150 against a maximum of 65. (Previously every error was caught and the test could not fail.)
precondition: Offline test harness; data is made up and built inside the test. No network, no AI model.

steps.action: Load made-up CSV, run all checks with schema and rules
steps.data: 5 employees; one age of 150 against a 18-65 rule; salary and department rules
steps.expected: Overall result is 'not passed' with exactly 1 issue; row-count and data-type checks pass, value-range check fails. The issue is for column age, rule 'max <= 65', on row index 4 (the fifth row).

name: Data Analyzer: Analysis runs cleanly on a JSON-loaded table and an Excel-style table
objective: Proves a table loaded from JSON text and a table built like an Excel sheet both analyse with no issues. (Previously errors were caught and printed, so the test always passed.)
precondition: Offline test harness; data is made up and built inside the test. No network, no AI model.

steps.action: Load made-up JSON text, run checks
steps.expected: The table has columns id, name, score and 3 rows; the analysis passes with 0 issues and reports shape 3 rows by 3 columns.

steps.action: Run checks on a made-up product table
steps.data: 3 product rows with a decimal price column
steps.expected: The analysis passes with 0 issues and detects the price column as float.

name: Data Analyzer: Row count, range and summary checks report the planted problems on a flawed table
objective: Runs the individual checks on made-up data with a duplicate id, blank values, bad ages and a mixed-case status. Proves each planted problem is reported against the right rows. (Previously nothing was asserted.)
precondition: Offline test harness; data is made up and built inside the test. No network, no AI model.

steps.action: Run the row-count check with minimum 3, then minimum 10
steps.expected: Minimum 3 passes and reports 5 rows; minimum 10 fails.

steps.data: ages 200 and -5 against 0-120; status 'ACTIVE' against allowed active/inactive/pending
steps.expected: 3 issues: age below 0 on row 3, age above 120 on row 1, and invalid value 'ACTIVE' on row 2.
Shape is 5 rows by 4 columns; missing values are id 1, email 1, age 0, status 0.

name: Data Analyzer: Automatic detection of column types recognises integers, decimals, text, dates and true/false
objective: Proves integer, decimal, text, ISO-date and true/false columns are recognised. (Previously the checks sat inside a catch-all handler, so a wrong answer still passed.)
precondition: Offline test harness; data is made up and built inside the test. No network, no AI model.

steps.action: Detect types for six made-up columns
steps.data: int, decimal, text, ISO date and true/false columns, plus a mixed column
steps.expected: int, float, str, datetime and bool are detected for the five clean columns (the mixed column is not asserted).
